verdict.rationale: Direct probes show Meilisearch serves a site-level llms.txt, which it says is maintained to help AI assistants. Its docs pages are also served as Markdown and point agents to a complete documentation index at /docs/llms.txt, so an agent can be aimed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these files, and no evidence of a full-content variant such as llms-full.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: This file is maintained by **Meilisearch** to help AI assistants
